info.title: Biho gifting, media and notification delivery
info.description: Owner-authorized batch at c749cec; independent Wallet/LiveKit reviews pending. int64 diamonds/quantities are exact JSON integer tokens. All timestamps UTC RFC3339. Missing providers fail closed; delivery is at least once, event IDs must be deduplicated. Display-order/ID catalog cursor follows current catalog ordering; edits between pages may change results. Other lists use ascending immutable IDs. Nullable optional description/asset/animation references clear those values; upload target omitted/null means authenticated actor. Originals private; provider/CDN configuration requires separate verification. Preferences explicitly opt in, default false. Real Garage, FCM and LiveKit data E2E NOT TESTED.

200.description: Committed financial operation and independent delivery status

previous_access_token.description: Only for an explicit account switch: valid access proof for the currently bound session on the same installation. Not persisted or returned. Ordinary logout clears the prior binding; an installation ID alone never permits cross-account overwrite.

delivery_status.description: delivered means provider accepted the data request; no per-participant animation receipt is asserted.
